evidence: We compared EFC to five different ML classifiers: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)... Naive Bayes (NB), and Support Vector Machine (SVM)
we assessed the average performance of the classifiers over ten different test sets
average performance and standard error (95% confidence interval) of each classifier
The metrics used to compare the results were the F1 score and the area under the ROC curve (AUC)
unresolved: The paper reports averaging over 'ten different test sets' (random resampling of train/test splits), not explicit random seeds -- treated as n_seeds=10 (repetition/trial count) per schema instructions, but this is resampling of data splits rather than a stated RNG seed list.
No formal significance test (e.g. t-test) is reported; only mean +/- standard error (95% CI) per classifier per metric, so significance_test is null.

n_eval_types counted as 2 (F1 score, AUC); qualitative analyses (energy histograms, feature-pair heatmap breakdown) are descriptive/interpretability results, not distinct quantitative evaluation metrics, so not counted separately.
